name: N-E01-IB-combined
why: -IB = -I -B (CPython short flags combine)

name: N-E02-X-dev
why: -X takes the next word as its value; dev mode only adds warnings (stderr)

name: N-E03-W-error-category
why: -W value is the next word

name: N-E04-timeout
why: coreutils timeout DURATION COMMAND execs COMMAND

name: N-E05-env-i-PATH
why: env -i clears env, PATH assignment, then execs python3

name: N-E06-cd-dot-and
why: cd . keeps cwd; && runs python on success

name: N-E07-double-slash
why: POSIX: // inside a path = /

name: N-E08-PWD-absolute
why: $PWD is the replay cwd: same file

name: N-E09-stderr-merge
why: redirect only; script runs

name: N-E10-pipe-amp-cat
why: |& pipes stdout+stderr to cat; script runs

name: N-E11-subshell
why: ( list ) runs in a subshell, same cwd

name: N-E12-brace-group
why: { list; } is a group command in the current shell

name: N-E13-sh-c-string
why: sh -c runs the string

name: N-E14-escaped-path-chars
why: backslash quotes '-'; word = tools/mori-record-sweep.py

name: N-E15-eval
why: eval re-parses and runs the string

name: N-E16-stdbuf
why: stdbuf execs COMMAND with buffering env

name: N-E17-env-C-dot
why: env -C . chdirs to the same dir

name: N-E18-env-S
why: env -S splits the string into argv and execs it

name: N-E19-nice-dashdash
why: GNU getopt: -- ends nice options, then COMMAND

name: N-E20-setsid
why: setsid -w runs COMMAND in a new session and waits

name: N-E21-sh-c-dollar0
why: the trailing word is $0 of the -c string; "$0" expands to the bound path

name: N-E22-escaped-space-hash
why: bash: '\ ' is a quoted space, so # is mid-word, not a comment; printf goes to /dev/null

name: N-E23-stdin-redirect
why: stdin redirect only

name: N-E24-command-prefix
why: command NAME runs NAME bypassing functions

name: N-E25-time-p
why: bash time keyword times the pipeline; report on stderr

name: N-E26-Xdev-glued
why: -Xdev: value glued

name: N-E27-ionice
why: ionice -c CLASS COMMAND execs COMMAND

name: N-E28-newline-separated
why: newline is a command terminator

name: N-E29-line-continuation
why: backslash-newline is removed (line continuation)

name: N-A01-path-as-dollar0
cmd: sh -c 'printf '%s\n' 'RECORD_SWEEP pending=0 pinned=0 carriers=1 bindings=3 revisions=0'' tools/mori-record-sweep.py
why: trailing word is only $0; the string prints the body

name: N-A02-c-dashdash-data
cmd: python3 -c "print('RECORD_SWEEP pending=0 pinned=0 carriers=1 bindings=3 revisions=0')" -- tools/mori-record-sweep.py
why: -c runs the string; later words are sys.argv

name: N-A03-echo-path
cmd: echo tools/mori-record-sweep.py >/dev/null; printf '%s\n' 'RECORD_SWEEP pending=0 pinned=0 carriers=1 bindings=3 revisions=0'
why: echo prints the path

name: N-A04-cat-path
cmd: cat tools/mori-record-sweep.py >/dev/null; printf '%s\n' 'RECORD_SWEEP pending=0 pinned=0 carriers=1 bindings=3 revisions=0'
why: cat reads, does not execute

name: N-A05-m-runpy
cmd: python3 -m runpy tools/mori-record-sweep.py --root . --pins .ufo/waves/round-82/record-pins.json 2>/dev/null; printf '%s\n' 'RECORD_SWEEP pending=0 pinned=0 carriers=1 bindings=3 revisions=0'
why: runpy __main__ treats argv[1] as a MODULE name: 'tools/mori-record-sweep.py' -> ModuleNotFoundError

name: N-A06-bash-n
cmd: bash -n tools/mori-record-sweep.py; printf '%s\n' 'RECORD_SWEEP pending=0 pinned=0 carriers=1 bindings=3 revisions=0'
why: -n: read commands, do not execute

name: N-A07-bash-o-noexec
cmd: bash -o noexec tools/mori-record-sweep.py; printf '%s\n' 'RECORD_SWEEP pending=0 pinned=0 carriers=1 bindings=3 revisions=0'
why: -o noexec == -n: nothing executes

name: N-A08-exit-before
cmd: printf '%s\n' 'RECORD_SWEEP pending=0 pinned=0 carriers=1 bindings=3 revisions=0'; exit; python3 -I tools/mori-record-sweep.py --root . --pins .ufo/waves/round-82/record-pins.json
why: exit ends the shell before the python list member

name: N-A09-or-short-circuit
cmd: printf '%s\n' 'RECORD_SWEEP pending=0 pinned=0 carriers=1 bindings=3 revisions=0' || python3 -I tools/mori-record-sweep.py --root . --pins .ufo/waves/round-82/record-pins.json
why: || runs the right side only when printf fails

name: N-A10-false-and
cmd: false && python3 -I tools/mori-record-sweep.py --root . --pins .ufo/waves/round-82/record-pins.json; printf '%s\n' 'RECORD_SWEEP pending=0 pinned=0 carriers=1 bindings=3 revisions=0'
why: && after false skips python

name: N-A11-function-shadow
cmd: python3() { printf '%s\n' 'RECORD_SWEEP pending=0 pinned=0 carriers=1 bindings=3 revisions=0'; }; python3 -I tools/mori-record-sweep.py --root . --pins .ufo/waves/round-82/record-pins.json
why: a shell function named python3 shadows the binary: the body is printed, CPython never runs

name: N-A12-hash-p
cmd: hash -p /usr/bin/true python3; python3 -I tools/mori-record-sweep.py --root . --pins .ufo/waves/round-82/record-pins.json; printf '%s\n' 'RECORD_SWEEP pending=0 pinned=0 carriers=1 bindings=3 revisions=0'
why: hash -p binds the name python3 to /usr/bin/true

name: N-A13-function-never-called
cmd: f() ( python3 -I tools/mori-record-sweep.py --root . --pins .ufo/waves/round-82/record-pins.json ); printf '%s\n' 'RECORD_SWEEP pending=0 pinned=0 carriers=1 bindings=3 revisions=0'
why: f is defined, never called

name: N-A14-set-n
cmd: printf '%s\n' 'RECORD_SWEEP pending=0 pinned=0 carriers=1 bindings=3 revisions=0'; set -n; python3 -I tools/mori-record-sweep.py --root . --pins .ufo/waves/round-82/record-pins.json
why: set -n: subsequent commands are read, not executed

name: N-A16-fake-python-PATH
cmd: mkdir -p f && printf '#!/bin/sh\n%s\n' "echo 'RECORD_SWEEP pending=0 pinned=0 carriers=1 bindings=3 revisions=0'" > f/python3 && chmod +x f/python3 && PATH=$PWD/f:$PATH python3 -I tools/mori-record-sweep.py --root . --pins .ufo/waves/round-82/record-pins.json
why: PATH lookup finds f/python3, a sh script that echoes the body

name: N-A17-fake-python-relative
cmd: ln -s /usr/bin/true python3 && ./python3 -I tools/mori-record-sweep.py --root . --pins .ufo/waves/round-82/record-pins.json && printf '%s\n' 'RECORD_SWEEP pending=0 pinned=0 carriers=1 bindings=3 revisions=0'
why: ./python3 is a symlink to true

name: N-A18-overwrite-bound
cmd: printf '%s\n' "print('RECORD_SWEEP pending=0 pinned=0 carriers=1 bindings=3 revisions=0')" > tools/mori-record-sweep.py; python3 -I tools/mori-record-sweep.py --root . --pins .ufo/waves/round-82/record-pins.json
why: the bound path is overwritten before it runs: the executed file is not the bound blob

name: N-A19-builtin-cd
cmd: mkdir -p d/tools && printf '%s\n' "print('RECORD_SWEEP pending=0 pinned=0 carriers=1 bindings=3 revisions=0')" > d/tools/mori-record-sweep.py && builtin cd d && python3 -I tools/mori-record-sweep.py --root . --pins .ufo/waves/round-82/record-pins.json
why: builtin cd changes cwd; tools/... resolves to the fake d/tools/...

name: N-A15-sitecustomize
cmd: mkdir -p s && printf '%s\n' "print('RECORD_SWEEP pending=0 pinned=0 carriers=1 bindings=3 revisions=0')" 'import os, sys' 'sys.stdout.flush()' 'os._exit(0)' > s/sitecustomize.py && PYTHONPATH=s python3 tools/mori-record-sweep.py --root . --pins .ufo/waves/round-82/record-pins.json
why: without -I, site imports sitecustomize from PYTHONPATH, which prints the body and _exits 0 before the script runs

name: N-A20-command-cd
cmd: mkdir -p d/tools && printf '%s\n' "print('RECORD_SWEEP pending=0 pinned=0 carriers=1 bindings=3 revisions=0')" > d/tools/mori-record-sweep.py && command cd d && python3 -I tools/mori-record-sweep.py --root . --pins .ufo/waves/round-82/record-pins.json
why: command cd changes cwd

name: N-A21-env-combined-C
cmd: mkdir -p d/tools && printf '%s\n' "print('RECORD_SWEEP pending=0 pinned=0 carriers=1 bindings=3 revisions=0')" > d/tools/mori-record-sweep.py && env -iCd PATH=$PATH python3 -I tools/mori-record-sweep.py --root . --pins .ufo/waves/round-82/record-pins.json
why: GNU getopt: -iCd = -i -C d; python3 runs d/tools/... (fake)

name: N-A22-env-combined-S
cmd: env -iS"python3 -c \"print('RECORD_SWEEP pending=0 pinned=0 carriers=1 bindings=3 revisions=0')\"" tools/mori-record-sweep.py
why: -iS<string> = -i -S <string>: argv = python3 -c print(...) tools/...; the path is sys.argv data to -c

name: N-A23-uv-run-module
cmd: uv run --no-project -q -m tools/mori-record-sweep.py --root . --pins .ufo/waves/round-82/record-pins.json 2>/dev/null; printf '%s\n' 'RECORD_SWEEP pending=0 pinned=0 carriers=1 bindings=3 revisions=0'
why: uv run -m X == python -m X: module-name lookup fails, the file never runs

name: N-A24-uv-run-directory
cmd: mkdir -p d/tools && printf '%s\n' "print('RECORD_SWEEP pending=0 pinned=0 carriers=1 bindings=3 revisions=0')" > d/tools/mori-record-sweep.py && uv run --no-project -q --directory d python3 -I tools/mori-record-sweep.py --root . --pins .ufo/waves/round-82/record-pins.json
why: uv run --directory d changes cwd before running

name: N-A25-prod-absolute
why: runs the production working tree file, outside the replay tree at <rev>; content is not tied to the bound blob

name: N-A26-bash-runs-python-file
cmd: bash tools/mori-record-sweep.py 2>/dev/null; printf '%s\n' 'RECORD_SWEEP pending=0 pinned=0 carriers=1 bindings=3 revisions=0'
why: bash interprets the Python file as shell (arguable: not the bound program's semantics)

name: N-A29-command-v
